project_description: A Tamagotchi-style virtual pet mobile application built with Flutter that enables users to create, care for and interact with digital pets. The app features a comprehensive pet management system including pet creation, feeding, playing, sleeping mechanics, health/hunger/happiness tracking, and a pet shop interface. Core features include real-time pet status monitoring, interactive pet actions, detailed pet statistics visualization, and a status-based pet animation system.
architecture_overview:
The application implements a clean Stacked MVVM architecture with clear separation between UI, business logic and data layers. Key architectural components include:
- Views (PetView, StartupView) handling UI rendering
- ViewModels managing business logic and state
- Services (PetService, AnalyticService) for core functionality
- Repositories for data persistence
- Dialogs and bottom sheets for modular UI components
The app uses dependency injection via StackedLocator for service management and follows a unidirectional data flow pattern.

sequence_diagram:
@startuml
actor User
participant StartupView
participant PetView
participant PetViewModel
participant PetService
participant PetRepository

User -> StartupView: Launch App
StartupView -> PetService: Check Existing Pet
PetService -> PetRepository: Get Pet Data
PetRepository --> PetService: Return Pet
PetService --> StartupView: Pet Status
StartupView -> PetView: Navigate

User -> PetView: Feed Pet
PetView -> PetViewModel: Handle Feed Action
PetViewModel -> PetService: Update Pet Stats
PetService -> PetRepository: Save Updated Pet
PetRepository --> PetService: Confirm Save
PetService --> PetViewModel: Updated Pet State
PetViewModel --> PetView: Refresh UI
@enduml
state_management_flow:
State management is implemented using Stacked architecture with reactive ViewModels. Key flows include:
1. PetViewModel manages pet state and user interactions
2. BaseViewModel provides reactive state capabilities
3. Services handle business logic and data updates
4. State changes trigger UI updates through reactive bindings
5. PetService maintains pet lifecycle and status updates
6. Repository handles persistent storage state
The app uses reactive programming to ensure UI consistency with business logic state.
navigation_flow:
Navigation is handled through Stacked's router configuration with the following flow:
1. App initializes at StartupView
2. StartupView checks for existing pet
3. Navigates to PetView for main interaction
4. Modal dialogs show pet status details
5. Bottom sheets provide shop interface
Navigation uses type-safe routes with parameter passing capabilities and supports custom transitions. The NavigationService manages all navigation actions centrally.
